usage: aleapp.py [-h] [-t {fs,tar,zip,gz}] [-o OUTPUT_PATH] [-i INPUT_PATH]
                 [-w] [-m LOAD_PROFILE] [-d LOAD_CASE_DATA]
                 [-c CREATE_PROFILE_CASEDATA] [-p]
                 [--custom_output_folder CUSTOM_OUTPUT_FOLDER]
                 [--custom_artifacts_path CUSTOM_ARTIFACTS_PATH]

ALEAPP: Android Logs, Events, and Protobuf Parser.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -t {fs,tar,zip,gz}    Specify the input type. 'fs' for a folder containing
                        extracted files with normal paths and names, 'tar',
                        'zip', or 'gz' for compressed packages containing
                        files with normal names.
  -o OUTPUT_PATH, --output_path OUTPUT_PATH
                        Path to base output folder (this must exist)
  -i INPUT_PATH, --input_path INPUT_PATH
                        Path to input file/folder
  -w, --wrap_text       Do not wrap text for output of data files
  -m LOAD_PROFILE, --load_profile LOAD_PROFILE
                        Path to ALEAPP Profile file (.alprofile).
  -d LOAD_CASE_DATA, --load_case_data LOAD_CASE_DATA
                        Path to LEAPP Case Data file (.lcasedata).
  -c CREATE_PROFILE_CASEDATA, --create_profile_casedata CREATE_PROFILE_CASEDATA
                        Generate an ALEAPP Profile file (.alprofile) or LEAPP
                        Case Data file (.lcasedata) into the specified path.
                        This argument is meant to be used alone, without any
                        other arguments.
  -p, --artifact_paths  Generate a text file list of artifact paths. This
                        argument is meant to be used alone, without any other
                        arguments.
  --custom_output_folder CUSTOM_OUTPUT_FOLDER
                        Custom name for the output folder
  --custom_artifacts_path CUSTOM_ARTIFACTS_PATH
                        Additional path to load artifacts from (e.g.,
                        scripts/alternate_artifacts)

--artifact_paths.help: Generate a text file list of artifact paths. This argument is meant to be used alone, without any other arguments.

--base-ref.help: commit to compare against, normally the merge base

--create_profile.help: Generate an ALEAPP Profile file (.alprofile) into the specified path. This argument is meant to be used alone, without any other arguments.

--create_profile_casedata.help: Generate an ALEAPP Profile file (.alprofile) or LEAPP Case Data file (.lcasedata) into the specified path. This argument is meant to be used alone, without any other arguments.

--csv-to-md.help: Only convert CSV to Markdown summary

--custom_artifacts_path.help: Additional path to load artifacts from (e.g., scripts/alternate_artifacts)

--custom_output_folder.help: Custom name for the output folder

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--keep.help: keep the --run output folder instead of deleting it

--list.help: print every match including allowlisted ones, then exit 0

--load_case_data.help: Path to LEAPP Case Data file (.lcasedata).

--local-repo.help: Path to local LAVA repo (relative to iLEAPP root)

--output_path.help: Path to base output folder (this must exist)

--root.help: scan this repository instead of the one this script lives in; BASELINE/ALLOWLIST still apply, so a sibling core reports its own findings as violations

--run.help: parse this corpus and compare produced rows to declared rows

--verbose.help: also report coverage and allowlist counts

--verify-hashes.help: re-hash every registered corpus; slow on large images

--wrap_text.help: Do not wrap text for output of data files

-t.help: Specify the input type. 'fs' for a folder containing extracted files with normal paths and names, 'tar', 'zip', or 'gz' for compressed packages containing files with normal names.
